tier1.criteria: Exact headword in both pools plus IPA, some attested morphology and etymology; not full morphology or editorially verified content.

tier2.label: Full deduplicated attested candidate lemma pool

capacity_recommendation.source_independence: Kaikki and WikiPron share Wiktionary origin. Source presence is not editorial verification.

wikipron.independence: Both WikiPron and Kaikki extracted from Wiktionary; normalization is exact-search, not ASCII.

camilleri.scope_note: Recursive CSV count includes data/new revisions; distinct lemma stems counted separately. Null - cells excluded.

masri_g2p.use: Local evaluation only; NC implementation is not copied into production or used to populate master IPA.
masri_g2p.sample_method: First N by SHA-256(word UTF-8), tie word; Gabra phonetic present AND WikiPron/Kaikki IPA; single-word headwords.
masri_g2p.normalization: Exact removes wrappers and segment whitespace only; tolerant folds ɪ/i, ɛ/e, ɔ/o, ʊ/u, ɐ/ə/ɑ/a, ħ/h, ɡ/g, affricate ligatures/ties, stress, syllable and length marks. This lossy equivalence is not phonetic accuracy.
masri_g2p.reference_limit: WikiPron and Kaikki are related Wiktionary snapshots; any listed pronunciation may match. Gabra phonetic selects sample but is not scored as a third independent gold standard.
